Headline: Borrow More: Share a 3,000 USDT prize pool based on qualifying borrowing activity.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## More ways to get rewarded with KuCoin Crypto Loans!
🏆 Borrow More: Share a 3,000 USDT prize pool based on qualifying borrowing activity.
🤝 Refer Friends: Share an additional 500 USDT prize pool when your referrals meet the loan requirements.
Join now
- Users must meet the applicable KuCoin, Crypto Loans product, and campaign eligibility requirements and complete registration, eligible deposits, and borrow during the campaign period.
- "First loan" means a user who had no Crypto Loan history (including fully repaid loans) under the master account or any sub-account before the campaign started, and who completes their first loan during the campaign.
- Master accounts and sub-accounts are treated as the same user. Loan amounts, interest, and reward eligibility are combined.
- The interest rebate is calculated on the interest actually accrued on the qualifying loan during the campaign. If the actual interest is lower than the cap, the rebate equals the actual interest. For early repayment, interest is calculated based on the actual holding period.
- "Average daily incremental loan balance" = the sum of daily loan balances during the campaign ÷ the number of campaign days − the loan balance in the snapshot on the campaign start date. A negative result is counted as zero.
- Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
- A user may not receive the same type of benefit under this campaign and any other loan rebate campaign at the same time.
- Please contact KuCoin Customer Support with any questions. KuCoin reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign.
